why: Software rendering (Mesa llvmpipe through EGL, forced with the glvnd vendor file). GPU rendering (NVIDIA EGL) is not repeatable: identical runs of the 500 reproduction seeds differ, so the repeat-run gate cannot hold. SPEC.md Risks table: 'GPU rendering is not repeatable -> switch to software rendering'.

comparison_on_reproduction_seeds.note: GPU agrees with the published per-seed file on 95.0% and 94.6% of seeds in two runs, Mesa on 93.8%. So GPU is closer by about 1 point, and SPEC step 8 alone would keep it. It is not chosen because identical GPU runs give different trajectories (137 of 500 identical) and Gate 0 needs identical repeats. The Risks table in SPEC.md names this case and its fallback, which is software rendering. Logged in DEVIATIONS.md.
